BRG_RELOAD_WRITE_NOT_COUNTER_SEED.rule: Writing STTMR alone does not change STTM; both reload register and counter must be assigned the same value beforehand for a fixed start period.

BRG_TIMER_AUTO_RELOAD_OVERFLOW.rule: Auto-reload timer overflow reloads STTMR into STTM and generates an overflow request; this is documentary behavior, not a performed clock event.

BUFFERED_NEXT_START_RAISES_TX_READY.rule: When previous transmission completes, buffered next data starts and a transmission interrupt request is generated at that new start.

BUSY_WRITE_CONTINUES_PREVIOUS_TRANSMISSI.rule: A documented write while previous transmission is active does not interrupt that previous transfer; the text describes next data beginning after it completes.

IDLE_STBUF_WRITE_STARTS_TRANSMISSION.rule: A qualified write when there is no previous transmission is the documented transmission trigger; no event is performed in M2cs.

RX_MODE_CHANGE_REQUIRES_SREN_ZERO.rule: Changing receiver operation mode must occur with receiving prohibited, SREN=0. This restriction is receiver-specific and is not copied onto STCON.

SHIFT_REGISTER_NOT_SOFTWARE_ACCESSIBLE.rule: Software cannot directly read or write the transmission shift register.

STBUF_RESET_UNAFFECTED_NO_DEFINED_VALUE.rule: Reset does not modify STBUF contents; this does not supply a known reset/current value.

STBUF_TO_SHIFT_HALF_CLK_DOC.rule: The body documents a half-CLK transfer/start relation and an illustrative200ns at10MHz; actual clock, elapsed time and ordering are not observed.

STBUF_WRITE_ONLY_8_LSB_FIRST.rule: STBUF at0051 is an8-bit write-only data buffer; bit0 is transmitted first, with selected data length.

TRANSMIT_TWO_STAGES.rule: STBUF holding buffer and separate transmit shift register form two stages; no arbitrary FIFO depth is established.

TX_READY_AT_START_IRQ_BIT2.rule: TXREADY is generated with M1ST instruction-start synchronization and sets IRQ word bit2 in the documented UART normal start sequence; it is not renamed TX COMPLETE.

TX_SETUP_BEFORE_STBUF.rule: Configure baud generation and transmission mode before a contemplated STBUF write.

UART_NORMAL_BRG_DIVIDE_16.rule: The UART normal description divides the BRG clock by16 to form STCLK; no actual frequency or general baud/reload formula is inferred.

UART_NORMAL_FRAME_END_STOP_BIT.rule: UART normal sends selected data LSB first, parity when designated, then stop bit to end one frame; a separate completion IRQ is not established.

UART_NORMAL_START_BIT_AFTER_STFREE_LOW.rule: STFREE is described as an internal progress signal becoming low; the next STCLK falling edge generates the start bit. No SFR address/bit mapping for STFREE is established.

UART_NORMAL_WSTBUF_LSTSF_START.rule: WSTBUF triggers LSTSF; STBUF contents move to the shift register at its falling edge, in this documented UART normal sequence.
